The '''''Conquest''''' was an early model [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alima]].

==History==
The ships's [[Time/Legends|first]] known [[Subjugation of Ithor|assignment]] was to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], where it hunted [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and was involved in the extortion of agricultural secrets from the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]].

In the wake of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] theft of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] ''Conquest'' was reassigned to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was one of the Star Destroyers that pursued the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Later, it was part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] permanent composition.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
